caption: The drawing features a single horizontal border strip placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The strip has a yellow base with slightly darker yellow stripes giving it a wood grain effect. Within the strip, there is a stylized organic pattern consisting of a continuous green vine with pointed, dark green leaves branching off alternately to the top and bottom. Along the vine, there are round, dark red dots regularly spaced between the leaves. The border has a thin, darker yellow outline at both the top and bottom edges of the strip. There are no other objects, shapes, or colors elsewhere on the drawing.
title: Decorative Panel from Rail Car Interior
